title: Number of Good Ways to Split a String
description: Calculate number of good splits where left and right parts have equal distinct character counts.
pseudocode: 1. Count distinct chars for right part; 2. Iterate and track left distincts; 3. Compare left and right distinct counts; 4. Increment result if equal.

steps.note: Initialize left/right frequency maps. Right map counts all chars: a:3, c:2, b:1.
Split at index 0 ('a', 'acaba'). Left distinct: 1, Right: 3. No match.
Split at index 1 ('aa', 'caba'). Left distinct: 1, Right: 3. No match.
Split at index 2 ('aac', 'aba'). Left distinct: 2, Right: 2. Good split!
Split at index 3 ('aaca', 'ba'). Left distinct: 2, Right: 2. Good split!
Split at index 4 ('aacab', 'a'). Left distinct: 3, Right: 1. No match.
